title: Taiv Ranks #12 on Deloitte’s 2026 Technology Fast 50 List
summary: Taiv ranked #12 on Deloitte’s 2026 Technology Fast 50, its second year in a row among Canada’s fastest-growing tech companies, with revenue up 2,803%.
body_markdown:
We’re thrilled to share that Taiv has been ranked #12 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ list for 2026, recognizing Canada’s fastest-growing technology companies. It’s the second year in a row Taiv has earned a spot on the list.


Returning to the Fast 50 is a strong sign that the technology and network we’ve built continue to deliver. Deloitte’s list recognizes the companies leading growth and innovation across Canada’s tech sector, and earning a top-15 ranking for the second year in a row is meaningful validation of the path we’re paving.


This year’s result is exceptionally more meaningful. The Fast 50 ranks companies by percentage revenue growth, which becomes harder to sustain as a company scales. Our 2025 ranking was measured from our earliest years of revenue. This year was measured from a much larger base, and Taiv still grew revenue 2,803%. Holding a top-12 spot at that scale shows our growth is keeping pace as we expand.


From the start, our mission has been to give venues more control over their screens. Taiv shows venue promotions and targeted ads during live TV commercial breaks, turning business TVs into tools that help bars, restaurants, and retailers engage their guests, while giving brands a way to reach fans in the moments they’re watching.


Ranking #12 reflects the hard work and commitment of our entire team. From developers to sales, operations, account management, onboarding, and installers across North America, everyone at Taiv contributed to this result.


Over the past year, we’ve grown to thousands of venues across the U.S. and Canada and expanded our team to match. This recognition from Deloitte tells us we’re headed in the right direction, and it pushes us to keep raising the bar.


We’re grateful to our customers, partners, and investors for their continued trust. This recognition belongs to you as well. Congratulations to every company on this year’s list!


[Learn more about Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 program →](https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/Industries/technology/research/fast50-winners.html)
